CustomField.label: Opportunity Owner:Division
CustomField.description: Division of the Opportunity Owner, sourced from the owning User standard Division field. Mirrors the existing Opportunity Owner:Team field (Opportunity_Owner_Team__c). Created to send to ChurnZero for higher-level (division) segmentation of opportunities. Requested by Chris.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The wider division of the Opportunity Owner, taken from the owner User record. Used for higher-level segmentation in ChurnZero (sits above the owner team).
